xna-type.name: KeyboardState
xna-type.summary: Represents a state of keystrokes recorded by a keyboard input device.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the KeyboardState class.

parameters.parameter: Array or parameter list of Keys to initialize as pressed.

constructor.remarks: Games normally use GetState to get the true keyboard state. This constructor is used instead to simulate keyboard input for passing within the game's own input subsystem.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Returns the state of a particular key.

method.name: Equals
method.summary: Returns a value that indicates whether the current instance is equal to a specified object.

overload.summary: Returns a value that indicates whether the current instance is equal to a specified object.

parameters.parameter: Object to compare this object to.

overload.returns: true if the objects are the same; false otherwise.

method.name: GetHashCode
method.summary: Gets the hash code for this instance.

overload.summary: Gets the hash code for this instance.

method.name: GetPressedKeys
method.summary: Gets an array of values that correspond to the keyboard keys that are currently being pressed.

overload.summary: Gets an array of values that correspond to the keyboard keys that are currently being pressed.
overload.returns: The keys that are currently pressed.

method.name: IsKeyDown
method.summary: Returns whether a specified key is currently being pressed.

overload.summary: Returns whether a specified key is currently being pressed.

parameters.parameter: Enumerated value that specifies the key to query.

overload.returns: true if the key specified by key is being held down; false otherwise.

method.name: IsKeyUp
method.summary: Returns whether a specified key is currently not pressed.

overload.summary: Returns whether a specified key is currently not pressed.

parameters.parameter: Enumerated value that specifies the key to query.

overload.returns: true if the key specified by key is not pressed; false otherwise.

method.name: op_Equality
method.summary: Compares two objects to determine whether they are the same.

overload.summary: Compares two objects to determine whether they are the same.

parameters.parameter: Object to the left of the equality operator.
Object to the right of the equality operator.

overload.returns: true if the objects are the same; false otherwise.

method.name: op_Inequality
method.summary: Compares two objects to determine whether they are different.

overload.summary: Compares two objects to determine whether they are different.

parameters.parameter: Object to the left of the inequality operator.
Object to the right of the inequality operator.

overload.returns: true if the objects are different; false otherwise.
